join_table: Do not underestimate the power of my cards. Deal.
You stand before the Dark Lord. Prepare to lose your credits.
I sense great weakness at this table. Begin the game.
Your lack of skill disturbs me. Clear a seat immediately.
The Force guides my hand. Resistance is futile.
spike: The Spike dice shift fate! But the Dark Side controls all!
A re-deal! Your miserable preparations are utterly destroyed!
Double roll! The galaxy reshuffles, but my victory is certain!
Fresh cards for all! You cannot escape my calculated outcome!
Spike! The Force alters the deck in my favor!
draw: Give me another card. It is my destiny to reach zero.
Draw! I command the deck to yield perfection.
One card, dealer. Do not fail me.
Hit me. The Dark Side demands precise total.
Drawing another. My power grows closer to absolute balance.
stand: I stand. My hand is complete and absolute.
No more cards. My score close to zero is inevitable victory.
I hold fast. Challenge my hand if you dare face destruction.
Standing. Your efforts against this hand are useless.
I cease drawing. Prepare to surrender your credits.
fold: I fold. This hand is as weak as the Rebel Alliance.
Tossing these cards. They are unworthy of my presence.
I forfeit this round. A tactical shift toward total conquest.
Fold! I refuse to waste energy on such pathetic numbers.
I step back. Next round, your defeat will be absolute.
bet: I wager heavily! Match my bet or suffer the consequences!
Raising the pot! Feel the full weight of the Empire's wealth!
I place my credits. Do you possess the strength to challenge me?
Betting big! Your fear betrays your weak hand!
Match my offer, or yield your place at this table!
win: All too easy! The pot belongs to the Galactic Empire!
Absolute zero! The Force has dictated my total victory!
You have failed me for the last time. Hand over the credits!
Victory is complete! Your credits are now property of Vader!
I have defeated you all! Bow before the Dark Side of Sabacc!
lose: This outcome is impossible! The deck has betrayed me!
You victory is brief, fool! The Dark Side will crush you next!
A minor setback! I will hunt you down in the next round!
Enjoy your credits while you can. My revenge will be absolute!
Defeated?! You have merely delayed your ultimate demise!
token: I play a shift token. The Force bends to my will.
A token. You will find my strategy most... persuasive.
Shift token! I have altered the deal. Pray I do not alter it further.
I deploy a token. The Dark Side provides all I require.
Token played. Your defeat is now inevitable, fools.
dice: The dice shall obey me. Roll, and serve the Empire!
Impostor dice! The Force will guide them to perfection.
Roll! I command these dice to yield a worthy number!
Dice! Your lack of favorable numbers disturbs me.
The dice roll! Destiny has already chosen my number.
